status: Prospective fresh-initialization hard/soft boundary ablation, chosen after historical signed residual diagnosis. No reference class inspection before freeze.
hyperparameter_selection: None; fixed budget. Validation diagnostic only.
physics_loss: mean complex squared PDE V + PDE I + driven interface /4 + short
data_loss: mean |V-Vref|^2+|I-Iref|^2, same geometry/xi stream and architecture
reference_cost: Reference fields generated on demand in both runs for shared diagnostic logging; included in training wall time and timed separately, never added twice
no_test_training: No reference labels or residual points from test/validation geometries; blocked d excluded from training
analytic_factor: R_s(a,d)=exp(-2 gamma a)*r_s(d); phase separation depends only on d
prefit_geometry_amendment: Initial 32+32 blocked proposal could not freeze: only61 admissible packed candidates remained. Changed to30+30 before any class/reference inspection or fitting; kept minimum distance and all other controls.

separation.scope: All prior neural train/validation/test protocol geometries. Conventional development sweeps are historical problem exploration.

transform: I=i; V=v-xi*v(1)-(1-xi)*(v(0)+(1+zs)*i(0)-2). Raw endpoint evaluations stay differentiable. No analytic solution, reflection target or labels inserted.

controls.sampling: Same saved geometry order and generator9000+seed in both arms; paired states share xi; batch32 geometries x4points x2states.
controls.objective: PDE(V)+PDE(I)+port/4+short, with BC terms identically zero for hard transform.
controls.selection: Minimum overall validation complex port-R RMS among steps0,500,1000,...4000. Full4000 training budget spent in every run. No validation-driven early stop or hyperparameter changes.
controls.final_holdout: Geometry-only set frozen before training. No final reference evaluations until all six selected checkpoint hashes are sealed.
controls.gate: Unchanged: blocked validation max-state R95<=.03, normalized joint right-field median L2<=.05, clear validation sensitivity/specificity>=.9 with both classes present. Missing class is inconclusive.
controls.ambiguity: within2deg of165 or .01 of magnitude.8; phase mask.05
controls.causal_limit: Hard enforcement also changes the trial-function representation. Improvement supports an enforcement bottleneck, not unique proof of gradient imbalance. Mixed residuals and cancellation remain possible.
controls.no_sweep: Exactly six predetermined fits. No factorial or new tuning unless separate diagnostic evidence and prospective justification.

difficulty_knob: d changes response non-monotonically. Report measured output-residual gain and detuning; do not label a geometry sweep monotonically harder.
